Package Controller

Class MapEditor

  • java.lang.Object
    • Controller.MapEditor
  • public class MapEditor
extends java.lang.Object
    This class contains utility functions for creating and editing maps to be used in the game. It is also the entry point to be used from main to access the map editor.

    • Method Detail

      • editMapEntry

        public void editMapEntry()
                  throws java.io.IOException
        This function contains the console commands and feedback loop for the Map Editor, it allows loading of maps, editing of maps, showing the map, validating maps, and saving maps. You are able to construct a map from an empty map by editing a filename which is not a current WarMap, you can then save this WarMap if you create a valid map by adding countrys, continents and neighbours.
        Throws:
        java.io.IOException
